title: Sign in with Google
summary: Add Google sign-in while keeping the existing approved-email access checks.
changes: Approved roster members can now choose Google sign-in from the Night Roster login screen.
Google returns to the existing Night Roster URL after authentication, then the same active allowed_users email check runs before any roster data opens.
Only Google is shown for social sign-in at this stage, so users are not offered an unconfigured Microsoft provider.
Email and password, password reset, passkeys, roster calculations, staffing, allocations and database permissions remain unchanged.
